subject: UCM P/PPI r007 independent review handoff
verdict_basis: One MED (REL7-01): the DKN-addressed publication gate is declarative; build_publication_plan labels a plan DKN_SELF_CERTIFIED on a caller-asserted PASS_SELF_CERTIFIED flag with no certificate verification and accepts the status with no certificate roots, so work-order item 6 cannot be confirmed and ledger repair PIPPI-PUBLICATION-01 is not met as stated. Everything else passes: handoff and archive custody, partition, all META certification records, qualification receipt binding to the exact source and release (closes REL4-01), externally pinned installer (closes REL4-02), 288/290 replay on 3.12.3 and 3.13.16 with the two non-passes Windows-host-only, byte-identical rebuild on both interpreters, and the revision/version-transition rules.
reviewer_independence: No involvement in building r007 or its operator kit; the carried UMT1 executed return is this reviewer's and was verified byte-identical.
execution: python3 -I -B in an empty environment on disposable copies; system CPython 3.12.3/3.13.16 for stdlib checks; previously authorized isolated venvs for subject execution; nothing installed; no network; installer, service, dashboard and operator kit read, not run; subject code executed only for run_public_release_qualification.py, build_release.py, verify_runtime_tree.py, read-only orientation and two documented-input exercises of public functions; no forged signatures, certificates or approvals.

findings.title: DKN-addressed publication plans accept a caller-asserted certificate status; the embedded self-certificate is never verified
evidence: src/ucm/pippi_integrations.py build_publication_plan: refuses dkn_public_namespace only when self_certificate_status != 'PASS_SELF_CERTIFIED'; thr_body_root/self_certificate_root optional and unchecked; never reads the artifact or META records
src/ucm/pippi_cli.py review-publication-proposal --self-certificate-status {READY..., PASS_SELF_CERTIFIED} passed through by pippi_reviews.propose_publication

tier2/publication/publication-plan-check.json: DKN + PASS_SELF_CERTIFIED with no certificate roots -> ACCEPTED, publication_identity_status DKN_SELF_CERTIFIED; with arbitrary roots -> ACCEPTED; READY or no status -> refused
src/ucm/release_certification.py: PASS_SELF_CERTIFIED is only produced after Ed25519 verification; verify_embedded_metadata exists but is not called by the plan path
REPAIR-LEDGER.json PIPPI-PUBLICATION-01 states the refusal is on the embedded certificate
findings.effect: A publication plan can be labelled DKN-self-certified for an artifact that has no certificate. No dispatch occurs in this release (provider_dispatch_authorized false, human_authorization_required true), but the plan is the record a publisher would consume and the ledger overstates the gate.
findings.repair: Derive self_certificate_status, self_certificate_root and thr_body_root from verify_embedded_metadata over the artifact named by artifact_sha256 (or the four META records supplied as inputs); remove the CLI flag; correct the ledger.

findings.title: Observations
evidence: Qualification receipt embeds python version, so its root is patch-version dependent; all other fields match the replay
Two of 290 qualification tests are Windows-only; the receipt's 0/0/0 is not reproducible on POSIX
IPC.key chmod 0o600 ineffective on Windows ACLs (unchanged)

unperformed_legs: Windows legs (item 8): installer, service, dashboard probe, uninstaller, mosaic_ui.win32
Content review of ecosystem return packages
Bound-certificate signature verification (subject unbound by design)
